name: RC-B10-0452/2026 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the human rights situation in Iran, notably the cases of Taraneh Rahimi and Leila Abolhasani
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It condemns Iran for crushing protests and for death sentences given to two women, Taraneh Rahimi and Leila Abolhasani. It asks Iran to cancel those sentences, stop all executions and free people held for their politics. It also asks the European Union to sanction Iranian officials and to support Iranian civil society.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. These are requests, not decisions.
- **Who it affects:** Iran's government, judges and officials; the two women and other prisoners.
- **What happens next:** The EU Council and countries decide whether to act on the requests.
